requirements.A: ordinary jobs come out in the order they were pushed
requirements.B: an urgent job overtakes every waiting ordinary job, and urgent jobs keep their own order

pops_from_the_back.why: released the most recently added ordinary job first

urgency_ignored.why: kept the shipped single list, so an urgent job waits its turn

urgent_jobs_reversed.why: put each urgent job at the very front, so urgent jobs come out backwards
